Hopefully, nobody is giving coffee to that dog. | ﻿Image: Xiaomi

The SkyNomad N90 Max is the latest electric SUV from Xiaomi and its first extended-range EV , with a claimed range of over 1,705 km (about 1,059 miles). It will come in both five- and seven-seat configurations, as well as an N90 Max Camping Edition.

One of the big features of the N90 is its highly customizable interior . The front seats rotate 180 degrees, the center armrest slides out to become a small table, and the second row features zero gravity seats with footrests.
